blocking: Reduced-motion mode still permits hover/focus scaling and button translation; shortening transition duration makes these changes instantaneous rather than removing them.
An inquiry response unconditionally moves keyboard focus to the status region, even when the visitor has moved on or is editing another field.

fixes.what: Under both .reduced and prefers-reduced-motion:reduce, disable the button hover translation and celebration-image hover/focus scaling explicitly.
fixes.why: Pause and reduced motion should stop these spatial effects, including keyboard-triggered scaling.

fixes.what: Keep the live status announcement, but move focus only if focus remains on the submit control; preserve focus when the visitor is editing or has navigated elsewhere.
fixes.why: A delayed response should not interrupt typing or unexpectedly move keyboard users.

fixes.what: Filter destination controls by their own viewport bounds before selecting a focus target; currently only the enclosing section is checked.
fixes.why: When the footer or inquiry section is partly visible, its first control can already be offscreen, leaving focus invisible because preventScroll is used.

fixes.what: Cache the previous morphing/docked states and toggle root classes only when those states change.
fixes.why: The root MutationObserver watches these classes; avoid redundant attribute mutations and observer work during every scroll update.
